title: logical sequence
rule: Sequence fields and choices in a logical, conventional order and make Tab order match that sequence.
pass_when: Visual order matches a conventional task order; Tab moves in that same order.
fail_when: Fields jump topics, or Tab order disagrees with visual order.
overview: Order fields conventionally and keep Tab order aligned with that sequence.
apply_when: Multi-field forms where task order and keyboard Tab matter.
not_when: Single-field screens with no sequence to establish.
agent_hint: Match visual order to conventional task order and align Tab with it.
description: Sequence fields and choices in a logical, conventional order and make Tab order match that sequence. Pass when visual order matches a conventional task order and Tab moves the same way; fail when fields jump topics or Tab order disagrees with visual order. Sequence and keyboard path should tell one story for sighted and keyboard users.
